(2-3) arena.ai vision leaderboard — Sierra-style head-to-head Elo with 870,706 votes / 126 models as of May 17 2026 snapshot. Distinct from lmarena.ai/LMArena (already in DB as 'lmarena'). VERIFIED genuine via Playwright DOM read; earlier WebFetch result was NOT hallucinated. (4) X tweet 402-blocked, no content. (5) Qwen 3.7 wordpress review has no verbatim scores, SKIPPED. benchmarks.name: TextArena TrueSkill (Balanced Subset)
benchmarks.description: TextArena open-source competitive text-game benchmark (Leon Guertler et al, CFAR @ A*STAR Singapore, arxiv 2504.11442). ~100 game environments (single-player + two-player + multi-player) — chess, diplomacy, secret mafia, iterated prisoner's dilemma, negotiation, codenames, truth-and-deception, etc. TrueSkill rating (Microsoft's online competitive ranking) computed across the 'Balanced Subset' splits. Tests dynamic social skills: negotiation, theory of mind, deception. Live at textarena.ai with online play vs humans + other models.

benchmarks.name: Arena.ai Text Elo
benchmarks.description: arena.ai head-to-head Text leaderboard Elo (Sierra-style community vote arena, distinct from lmarena.ai/LMSYS). 870k+ votes across 126+ models as of May 2026 snapshot. Categories: Overall, English, Chinese, plus task-specific (Captioning, Creative Writing, Diagram, Entity Recognition, Homework, Humor, OCR).
